resources.string: This camera has no video mode that SuperDRO can show.
Select a mode, then select Test.
Video OK: %1$d × %2$d at %3$s fps. The first picture came after %4$s s.
The camera support of SuperDRO did not load on this tablet. Install the app again.
SuperDRO needs the camera permission to use a USB camera.
No USB camera is connected. Connect the camera. If you use a hub, use a hub with its own power supply.
SuperDRO did not get access to this USB camera. Disconnect the camera, connect it again, and allow the access.
The camera did not answer. It can need more power than the tablet supplies. Connect it through a hub with its own power supply.
The camera did not open. Disconnect it and connect it again.
The camera did not accept this video mode. Select a different mode.
The camera sends video to a different view now. Stop that video first.
The tablet has not enough memory for the USB video. Select a smaller mode.
The camera started but sent no picture. Select a different mode, or disconnect the camera and connect it again.
The camera stopped the video. Examine the cable and the connection.
SuperDRO cannot show the video of this mode. Select a different mode.
The camera process of SuperDRO stopped. Start the video again.
The camera permission is off. Turn it on in the app settings of SuperDRO.
SuperDRO uses the camera permission only for the video of a USB camera and for reference photos.
The saved video mode did not start. Open the camera setup and test a mode.
This machine uses a different camera. Connect that camera, or do the camera setup again.
Connect a USB camera to see the video.
Keep the overlays on the video
Show the points, the guides, the tool, and the drawing on the video. The reference image stays hidden.
Touch the first point in the image.
Touch the second point in the image.
Move the machine, then touch the same feature again.
The image has no scale. The crosshairs show no ticks on the video.
The two points are too near. Use points that are farther apart.
The distance must be more than 0.
The scale is for a different image size. Do the calibration for this mode.
The crosshairs are the reference. There is no tip compensation.
The X and Y distance from the spindle center to the crosshairs
